question:
B. Is this measure already running in Satakunta wellbeing services county (or in the Tyks university hospital area that treats its patients)?
A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure shorten the time from first symptom to treatment start for lung cancer patients, and by how many days?
Measure: Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots. A lung cancer pathway on the Danish/Swedish/Norwegian model: fixed referral criteria, pre-booked CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots, a named pathway owner, and published time limits for each step.
effect_summary_en: Lung Cancer Europe (2026) reports that in Denmark the time from first referral to start of treatment fell from 56 to 42 days, a cut of 14 days, which matches the assumed value.
supported_en: Lung Cancer Europe reports Danish referral-to-treatment time for lung cancer fell from 56 to 42 days (14 days). All.Can reports the Danish wait for any cancer diagnosis fell from 49 to 35 days.
not_supported_en: The 14 days comes from a summary by an advocacy group, not a study I read; nothing shows the gain would be the same in Satakunta or covers the time from first symptom.

in_use_summary_en: Satakunta wellbeing services county runs an early-diagnosis lung cancer pathway with fixed criteria (at least 20 pack-years of smoking plus symptoms) that let primary care send patients straight to lung CT. It started as a pilot in early 2022 and became routine in 2024. Tyks publishes average waiting times for lung cancer care.
missing_en: No page shows pre-booked PET-CT, bronchoscopy or MDT slots, a named pathway owner, or published time limits (targets) for each step.
summary_en: Satakunta wellbeing services county says its early-diagnosis lung cancer pathway (fixed criteria, direct CT from primary care) started as a pilot in 2022 and has been routine since 2024. Tyks publishes average waits for lung cancer care. Lung Cancer Europe reports that Denmark's pathway cut referral-to-treatment time for lung cancer from 56 to 42 days, which matches the assumed 14 days.
unanswered_en: I found no page on booked imaging, bronchoscopy or MDT slots, a pathway owner or time limits for each step in Satakunta or Tyks, and no study of the Danish 14-day figure.
